original.question: Evaluate $\int\frac{2x^{2}+3}{x(x-1)^{2}}\,dx$.
original.answer: Write $\frac{2x^{2}+3}{x(x-1)^{2}}=\frac Ax+\frac B{x-1}+\frac C{(x-1)^{2}}$, so $2x^{2}+3=A(x-1)^{2}+Bx(x-1)+Cx$. Setting $x=0$: $A=3$; setting $x=1$: $C=5$; equating $x^{2}$ coefficients: $A+B=2$, so $B=-1$. Then $\int=3\ln|x|-\ln|x-1|-\frac{5}{x-1}+C$.

original.question: Evaluate $\int\frac{3x}{(x-1)(x^{2}+6)}\,dx$.
original.answer: Write $\frac{3x}{(x-1)(x^{2}+6)}=\frac A{x-1}+\frac{Bx+C}{x^{2}+6}$, so $3x=A(x^{2}+6)+(Bx+C)(x-1)$. Setting $x=1$: $A=\frac37$. Equating $x^{2}$ coefficients: $A+B=0$, $B=-\frac37$; constants: $6A-C=0$, $C=\frac{18}{7}$. Then $\int=\frac37\ln|x-1|-\frac3{14}\ln(x^{2}+6)+\frac{3\sqrt6}{7}\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{\sqrt6}+C$.
